title: Learning From the Best: What Makes Popular Hugging Face Models?
abstract: arXiv:2611.20227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hugging Face has become a central platform for sharing and reusing pre-trained models, yet it remains unclear which practices are associated with higher visibility and adoption. Prior studies describe model reuse and model-card quality but do not systematically compare popular and unpopular models across documentation, repository structure, platform metadata, and technical metadata. We studied 66,909 Hugging Face models collected on 2026-02-28 and extracted 31 features across four dimensions: Documentation, Models, Platforms, and Techniques. For downloads and likes, we compared the top 10% popular models with the bottom 80% using statistical tests and effect sizes, trained five classifiers to predict popularity, ranked feature importance with the best-performing model, and tested whether predictions held across model domains and contributor affiliations. Popular models consistently had longer model cards, more code examples, and more Git

translated_title: 向最佳学习：是什么让Hugging Face模型广受欢迎？
translated_abstract: Hugging Face已成为共享和复用预训练模型的核心平台，但哪些实践与更高的可见度和采用率相关仍不明确。先前的研究描述了模型复用和模型卡质量，但并未从文档、仓库结构、平台元数据和技术元数据等方面对流行与不流行的模型进行系统性比较。我们研究了于2026年2月28日收集的66,909个Hugging Face模型，并从文档、模型、平台和技术四个维度提取了31个特征。针对下载量和点赞数，我们使用统计检验和效应量将最流行的前10%模型与最不流行的后80%模型进行比较，训练了五个分类器来预测流行度，利用表现最佳的模型对特征重要性进行排序，并验证了预测结果在不同模型领域和贡献者所属机构之间是否成立。流行模型始终拥有更长的模型卡、更多的代码示例以及更多的Git（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究对66,909个Hugging Face模型进行系统分析，发现完善的文档质量（如更长的模型卡和更多的代码示例）等特征是模型获得高下载量和点赞数的关键因素。
